Thanks for the context, Ava. I reviewed the forwarded log and your coaching notes. Before we consider a formal PIP we need a defensible evidence bundle and a clear, measurable success criterion. I’m attaching our standard scope/checklist for PIP initiation — it outlines required steps and timelines (investigation, witness statements, prior coaching artifacts, performance metrics).

Key asks from HR/legal to unblock drafting a formal notice:
1) A concise manager summary (1–2 pages) of prior interventions and current behaviors with dates and outcomes (please use the attached template).
2) Copies of the two prior coaching notes and the April written counseling (redact any unrelated personal info).
3) Concrete metrics for the role (deployment frequency, mean time to recovery, PR rejection rate) with a 30/60/90 day target.
4) Confirmation that we will offer a mid-point review and coaching sessions documented in the employee’s calendar.

We should avoid language that presumes intent. Once we have the packet HR will do an initial legal screen and advise whether a formal PIP or alternative corrective plan is the recommended approach.

I’m available for the 1pm triage call. Attaching: pip_scope_checklist.xlsx
